title: Carter-Ashley Hall, Quantum OS 2000 Professional, & The Chickenshit Report
description: Moving into Carter-Ashley Hall with Level 3 sign-out privileges, Katie and Nate start the Web Applications Developer course—where their instructor lets them sit together, everyone uses their own laptops because the Commonwealth's locked-down Quantum OS 2000 Professional desktops are useless for modern PHP, they bond with middle-aged classmates Tina, Jim, and Sheila, and a violent afternoon in the therapeutic pool lands Nate on the morning 'Chickenshit Report.'
